svg.title: Idealized heating of one kilogram of pure water
svg.desc: Temperature against net heat added, at fixed pressure near one atmosphere. A-B ice warms from minus 10 to zero Celsius. B-C melting at zero, 334 kilojoules. C-D liquid warms to 100 Celsius. D-E boiling at 100, 2256 kilojoules. E-F vapor warms to 110. Horizontal lengths are proportional to heat added. No time axis.

g.text: Pure water, 1 kg, fixed pressure near one atmosphere
A-B ice warms. B-C ice and liquid coexist during melting.
C-D liquid warms. D-E liquid and vapor coexist during boiling.
E-F vapor warms. Short A-B and E-F segments reflect the energy scale.
Calculated illustrative model, not measured data or a heating procedure.
Original diagram. Assumptions and full numeric table are in the academic packet.
